title: The SP-ovwzbc7u review's doc and gap-note findings are fixed
goal: The arXiv Closed note in kb/public/_gaps.md either cites a tagged agents/doc-lookup-sources.md fact stating the v1 and v7 licence-link result or is a dated Tried note with the entry left open; the CIS benchmarks Resolved note in kb/public/_gaps.md either cites a tagged security/management-plane-hardening.md fact stating the SQL Server 2019 and Alpine Linux result or is a dated Tried note with the entry left open; the two robocopy Partly resolved notes in kb/public/_gaps.md either cite tagged windows/robocopy.md facts stating the KB 954404, archive blog and KB 310316 findings or are dated Tried notes with the entry left open; kb/_self/backlog.md says the kb's backlog.json names every key but hooks and naming; kb/_self/backlog.md and skills/sprint/SKILL.md carry no sprint or story id in the rule text on stories that change the same function

run: g=open('kb/public/_gaps.md',encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines();r=open('kb/public/agents/doc-lookup-sources.md',encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines();bad=[l for l in g if 'Closed' in l and '1706.03762v1' in l];art=any('1706.03762' in l and 'v7' in l and l.rstrip().endswith(']') for l in r);assert not bad or art, 'arXiv Closed note stands with no tagged v1/v7 fact in the article'

g=open('kb/public/_gaps.md',encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines();r=open('kb/public/security/management-plane-hardening.md',encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines();bad=[l for l in g if 'Resolved 2026-10-21' in l and 'cisecurity.org/cis-benchmarks' in l];art=any('2019' in l and 'Alpine' in l and l.rstrip().endswith(']') for l in r);assert not bad or art, 'CIS Resolved note stands with no tagged 2019/Alpine fact in the article'

g=open('kb/public/_gaps.md',encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines();r=open('kb/public/windows/robocopy.md',encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines();bad=[l for l in g if 'Partly resolved 2026-10-21' in l and ('KB 954404' in l or 'KB 310316' in l)];art=all(any(k in l and l.rstrip().endswith(']') for l in r) for k in ('954404','310316','deploymentguys'));assert not bad or art, 'robocopy Partly resolved notes stand with no tagged KB 954404/310316 facts in the article'
import re;t=open('kb/_self/backlog.md',encoding='utf-8').read();m=re.search(r'names every key but ([^,]*),',t);assert m and 'naming' in m.group(1), m and m.group(1)

import re;N='hat change the same function get checks';P=r'\b(SP|ST|BG|TK|EP|SB)-[a-z0-9]{8}\b';a=[l.split(N)[1] for l in open('kb/_self/backlog.md',encoding='utf-8') if N in l];b=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read().split(N)[1].split('A committed item whose touches name code')[0];h=[x for x in a+[b] if re.search(P,x)];assert a and not h, 'ids in the rule text: %d' % len(h)

notes: Found by the SP-ovwzbc7u review on 2026-10-23: the arXiv Closed note cites doc-lookup-sources.md:102, which says only the unversioned address was read; the CIS Resolved note cites management-plane-hardening.md:41, which has no 2019 or Alpine result; the robocopy notes cite robocopy.md lines that hold none of KB 954404, the archive blog or KB 310316; backlog.md names every key but hooks while backlog.json has no naming; backlog.md and skills/sprint/SKILL.md carry an incident story with sprint and story ids in the rule text. Each check fails on an AssertionError naming its premise.
